title: Lightroom Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lightroom:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often lightroom metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on lightroom metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you how often your lightroom metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
